mapper.select: SELECT role.code FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role.code

SELECT DISTINCT permission.code FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY permission.code
